thread:
Ana (Marketing): Quick design ask — bench tiles + email hero for launch next Wed. Need brand-safe variants and a 'bench spotlight' 600x340 hero for email, 1200x628 social card, and modular tiles (300x300) for blog/docs. Figma link: https://figma.com/file/xyz/bench-launch (view only). Also legal wants language options and a conservative metric framing.

Kai (Design): On it. Can you confirm the metric callouts we can use? e.g., '2x lower cost' vs 'up to 2x'? Legal flagged absolute claims last time.

Jessie D: Prefer 'up to 2x' or show ranges + a small footnote. For the email hero: CTA center-left, brand gradient only, no competitor logos. Include alt text and small-screen crop checks for accessibility.

Ruth (Legal): Agree with Jessie. No absolute comparative claims without signed customer data. Use conservative phrasing: 'up to 2x' or 'reduced per-token cost' + link to methodology. We need copy sign-off before launch.

Matt G: Timeline: first comps by Tue EOD so webinar/content can review. Also need localized variants (EN, FR, DE). Export: 1x PNG, 2x retina, and SVG where applicable.

Kai (Design): Will push comps. Quick Q — dark-mode variants needed? Marketing: might show in docs. Also will prepare a simplified icon set for tiles to maintain consistency.

Ana (Marketing): Yes to dark-mode. Localization priority: EN then FR, then DE if time allows. I'll provide the short copy strings for each locale today.

DesignOps Bot: Reminder — export presets: 1x PNG (sRGB), 2x PNG (retina), optimized SVG. Naming convention: campaign_bench_{size}_{locale}_{variant}.{ext}. Please upload final assets to /marketing/bench-launch/ in Figma and add export slices.

Kai (Design): Got it. Will include layered Figma file and production slices. Any brand guardrail tweaks? We had a gradient token v3 rolled last week.

Jessie D: Use gradient v3 for the hero. Tiles should use neutral backgrounds and maintain text contrast >= 4.5:1 for body copy. I'll run a quick contrast pass.

Ruth (Legal): When comps are uploaded tag me and @Ana for copy review. If we reference third-party or benchmark numbers, include a footnote URL or remove the claim.

Ana (Marketing): I'll drop the localized copy into the figma notes and highlight where metrics appear. FYI the webinar team also asked for a short explainer GIF (loop, 800x450) — can we include a simple motion pass?

Kai (Design): Can do a simple 3-frame GIF for the explainer. Adding it to scope but still prioritizing stills for Tue.

Matt G: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Ping me when comps are uploaded so I can coordinate review with webinar and sales plays. :thumbsup:

DesignOps Bot: Action items checklist: 1) Comps (hero + social + tiles) uploaded by Tue EOD; 2) Dark-mode variants; 3) Localized copy added to Figma; 4) Legal review tagged; 5) Export slices + naming conventions applied; 6) Optional 3-frame GIF.

Ana (Marketing): Great checklist. I'll post copies in the figma comments in 30m and add translation notes. Thanks everyone!
